subject: Junior Civil Construction Estimator, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Jr Civil Construction Estimator role advertised on SEEK. I live in Melton, and the role's mix of drawing review, take-offs and supplier pricing builds directly on the estimating coursework in my diploma.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. It included cost estimates and bills of quantities, hand calculations, and road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, so the numbers side of the ad suits me. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020, first on a community hall renovation and then on subdivision finishing works: reviewing drawings, checking the work against them, tracking procurement and materials, and coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors to keep work moving.

I haven't worked in a paid estimating role yet, and I use Excel but haven't used Bluebeam or E1, so those would be new to me. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and I can travel for remote works.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to come in and talk it through.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Jr Civil Construction Estimator
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Jr Civil Construction Estimator role advertised on SEEK. I live in Melton, so the Melbourne base works, and the role's mix of drawing review, quantity take-offs and supplier pricing builds directly on the estimating coursework in my diploma.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities, hand calculations, options analysis and risk registers, alongside road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage designs that I drew in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides. Reviewing drawings and putting quantities and costs against them is work I have done in study, and the maths side of the ad is the part I'm most comfortable with. Before the diploma I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered hydraulics, structural principles and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, suppliers and subcontractors to sort out site issues and keep work moving.

Where I fall short of the ad: I haven't worked in a paid estimating role yet, and I use Excel but haven't used Bluebeam or E1, so I would be learning those from the start. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I can travel for remote works.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome the chance to come in and talk it through.

checklist: Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter).
Paste the screening answers above and fill the two placeholders (salary, notice).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "SEEK".
notes: Direct employer, Melbourne, junior estimating role with no years bar; Bluebeam and E1 are listed under About you without "essential", so they are disclosed as gaps rather than treated as a hold (the ad marks only maths skills as essential). Contact research (28 Sep 2026): CBX Group Pty Ltd is a new company (ABN registered April 2026, Melbourne bayside); its website cbxgroup.com.au is a one-page placeholder with no people, projects or contact details, so no direct contact exists and the only route is SEEK. Worth asking on a call who the estimating team reports to and what projects the remote works are.
